description: This file defines the PHP class 'Chart_pipeline_by_sales_stage' which generates a pipeline chart based on sales stages within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for drawing the chart, generating XML data for chart rendering, and constructing database queries related to opportunities and sales stages. The code handles user preferences, date ranges, sales stages, user filtering, and chart caching.

classes.name: Chart_pipeline_by_sales_stage
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering a sales pipeline chart by sales stage, including data retrieval, XML generation, and user interface components in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Generates and outputs the HTML and chart XML for the sales stage pipeline visualization, including user interface controls for filtering and preferences.

methods.name: gen_xml
methods.description: Creates XML data representing the pipeline chart, with data fetched from the database based on filters such as sales stages, user IDs, and date range. It handles caching and chart rendering.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds and returns an SQL query string to fetch opportunity data filtered by sales stages, user IDs, and date range.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Returns an array of fields to group the SQL query results by, specifically 'sales_stage' and 'user_name'.
